comment: Deliberate exceptions to MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2. Every entry needs a written reason. Knowledgebase reaches Memory and Drive in-process by default; only a deliberate split deployment may opt into HTTP.

allow.reason: Opt-in split deployment only: SDKWORK_KNOWLEDGEBASE_MEMORY_MODE=http selects the Memory App API provider; the default is the in-process memory runtime over the shared PostgreSQL, and bootstrap fails when the base URL is missing or malformed.
